responsibility: Implements MIR-based source coverage instrumentation for eligible functions by deciding when coverage applies, deriving a coverage-specific control-flow graph from MIR, refining executable source spans and branch mappings, assigning physical counters and derived counter expressions to graph blocks and edges, injecting the resulting coverage statements into MIR, and assembling the final coverage metadata for codegen. The module also includes developer diagnostics and visualization for inspecting coverage graphs, spans, counters, and instrumentation decisions, plus dedicated test scaffolding and helper macros that validate the graph and counter behavior.
